title: euphrasia stricta var. slovaca
intro: Euphrasia stricta var. slovaca, commonly known as a type of eye-bright, is a plant species in the family Orobanchaceae. This plant is traditionally used for its health benefits, which include supporting the health of the eyes, reducing inflammation, and relieving respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Euphrasia stricta var. slovaca are attributed to its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, an antiseptic, and an expectorant, making it useful in the treatment of conditions such as conjunctivitis and bronchitis. The bioactive constituents responsible for its therapeutic effects include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and iridoid glycosides, which have been shown to possess antioxidant and antimicrobial properties.
